package.name: sm_coretest_post_during_exit_1
package.description: Core test: a component posts an ABSOLUTE event at pulse_rate_hz from a node timer on the executor thread while a 50 ms CbSleepFor cycles two states, so that ISmaccStateMachine::postEvent reads the current state and walks its reactors while the state machine thread is exiting that state. Reproduces the Next Level Study NL-2 race without a simulator; run under ThreadSanitizer.
